sentences.text: British Airways -LRB- BA -RRB- is the largest airline in the United Kingdom based on fleet size , or the second largest , behind easyJet , when measured by passengers carried .	United Kingdom	United Kingdom	easyJet	easyJet

The airline is based in Waterside near its main hub at London Heathrow Airport .	Heathrow Airport	Heathrow Airport	Waterside	Waterside (building)	hub	Airline hub	London Heathrow Airport	London Heathrow Airport

In January 2011 BA merged with Iberia , creating the International Airlines Group -LRB- IAG -RRB- , a holding company registered in Madrid , Spain .	International Airlines Group	International Airlines Group	Iberia	Iberia (airline)	holding company	holding company	Madrid	Madrid
IAG is the world 's third-largest airline group in terms of annual revenue and the second-largest in Europe .
It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and in the FTSE 100 Index .	London Stock Exchange	London Stock Exchange	FTSE 100 Index	FTSE 100 Index

BA was created in 1974 after a British Airways Board was established by the British government to manage the two nationalised airline corporations , British Overseas Airways Corporation and British European Airways , and two regional airlines , Cambrian Airways from Cardiff , and Northeast Airlines from Newcastle upon Tyne .	British Overseas Airways Corporation	British Overseas Airways Corporation	British European Airways	British European Airways	Cambrian Airways	Cambrian Airways	Cardiff	Cardiff	Northeast Airlines	Northeast Airlines (UK)	Newcastle upon Tyne	Newcastle upon Tyne
On 31 March 1974 , all four companies were merged to form British Airways .
After almost 13 years as a state company , BA was privatised in February 1987 as part of a wider privatisation plan by the Conservative government .	Conservative government	Second Thatcher ministry

The carrier expanded with the acquisition of British Caledonian in 1987 , Dan-Air in 1992 , and British Midland International in 2012 .	British Caledonian	British Caledonian	Dan-Air	Dan-Air	British Midland International	British Midland International
A long-time Boeing customer , BA ordered 59 Airbus A320 family aircraft in August 1998 .	Boeing	Boeing	Airbus A320 family	Airbus A320 family
In 2007 it purchased 12 Airbus A380s and 24 Boeing 787 Dreamliners , marking the start of its long-haul fleet replacement .	Boeing	Boeing	long-haul	flight length
The centrepiece of the airline 's long-haul fleet is the Boeing 777 , with 58 in the fleet .	Boeing	Boeing	long-haul	flight length	Boeing 777	Boeing 777
BA is the largest operator of the Boeing 747-400 , with 41 registered to the airline .	Boeing	Boeing	Boeing 747-400	Boeing 747-400

It is a founding member of the Oneworld airline alliance , along with American Airlines , Cathay Pacific , Qantas , and the now defunct Canadian Airlines .	Oneworld	Oneworld	American Airlines	American Airlines	Cathay Pacific	Cathay Pacific	Qantas	Qantas	Canadian Airlines	Canadian Airlines
